I can’t reliably compute the final values for this long sequence by hand, and I don’t want to guess. You can evaluate it exactly in R by pasting the assignments into `code` and running:

```r
code <- "PASTE THE ASSIGNMENTS HERE"
eval(parse(text = gsub("mod 100", "%% 100", code)))

cat(paste(
  sprintf("%s ?= %s", c(letters[1:16], "TMP"),
          sapply(c(letters[1:16], "TMP"), function(x) get(x))),
  collapse = "; "
), "\n")
```
